title: Yummy Crumbly Ukrainian Taleggio Blini
description: A malty, crumbly, one-pot Ukrainian dish featuring taleggio cheese served with sashimi-cut vegetables, perfect for a gluten-free-friendly breakfast or snack. This tandoor clay pot recipe is quick and easy to prepare.
instructions: Combine gluten-free oat flour, taleggio cheese, and a pinch of salt in a large mixing bowl.
Gradually add 1 cup of water to the mixture to form a crumbly dough.
Knead the dough for 2 minutes until it comes together in a ball.
Place the dough in a lightly oiled tandoor clay pot and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Bake the dough in the preheated oven for 25 minutes or until it's golden brown and crispy on the outside.
While the dough is baking, prepare the sashimi-cut vegetables by peeling and cutting them into thin strips.
Once the dough is done, remove it from the oven and let it cool for 2 minutes.
Cut the cooled dough into pieces and serve with the prepared sashimi-cut vegetables.
Garnish with fresh dill for a pop of color and flavor.
